test_glob_tool_ignores_common_dirs: test the glob_tool function to find files by pattern while ignoring node_modules and other common directories
test_grep_tool_filters_by_glob: test the grep_tool function to search for text patterns filtered by glob and skipping binary files
test_grep_tool_literal_mode: test the grep_tool function with literal=True to treat the search pattern as plain text instead of regex
test_aio_sandbox_glob_filters_ignored: test the AioSandbox.glob method to filter out ignored directories like node_modules from results
test_aio_sandbox_grep_parses_json: test the AioSandbox.grep method to search files and parse JSON API responses into GrepMatch objects
